residual_risks: The source already gives an O(h) local generator discrepancy at degenerate counts; novelty is specifically the exact global transition law, sharp survival floor and contrast with unadjusted scheme, not generic inconsistency.

value.rationale: The adjustment is designed to repair degenerate (low-count) channels. Its unexpected exact 3/4 survival floor for the common midpoint setting, compared to exact exponential survival in the unadjusted scheme, is an explicit predictive failure with sharp step and a wrong zero-step limit. It motivates special handling of near-extinction reactions and prevents mistaking local large-count accuracy for survival reliability.
